title: Panel Conditioning in Fixed-Effects Models: Identification and Bias Propagation
abstract: arXiv:2609.28871v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Panel conditioning, the causal effect of prior survey participation on responses, can vary with tenure. Under an additive model of cell means in period, entry cohort, and tenure, we characterize which features of the conditioning path a staggered panel identifies on its observed support, and how the unidentified component affects common panel estimators. The identified set of the path is an affine translate of the tenure projection of the cell design's kernel, and a linear functional of the path is identified exactly when it annihilates that projection. It always contains an affine direction and, when the entry cohorts share a stride, periodic directions, which exhaust it under a connectivity condition on observed increments; second differences at that stride are then identified, and ordinary ones generally are not when the stride exceeds one. translated_title: 固定效应模型中的面板条件效应：识别与偏差传播
translated_abstract: 面板条件效应（panel conditioning），即先前参与调查对回答所产生的因果效应，可能随受访时长（tenure）而变化。在按时期、进入队列与受访时长划分的单元格均值的加性模型下，我们刻画了交错面板在其观测支撑集上能识别条件效应路径的哪些特征，以及未识别部分如何影响常见的面板估计量。该路径的识别集是单元格设计之核在受访时长方向上投影的仿射平移，而路径的线性泛函恰好在其零化该投影时方可被识别。识别集总包含一个仿射方向；当各进入队列共享同一采样步长时，还包含周期方向，并且在观测增量的连通性条件下这些方向穷尽识别集。此时，该步长下的二阶差分可被识别，而当步长大于一时，普通的（相邻）二阶差分一般不可识别。在一定的样本补充条件下，诸如“四-八-四”轮换这类中断式的抽样安排……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文在时期—进入队列—受访时长的加性面板模型下，刻画了交错面板对面板条件效应路径的可识别特征（识别集为设计核之时长投影的仿射平移，包含仿射方向与周期方向，并在连通性条件下被其穷尽），进而说明未识别成分如何向常见面板估计量传播偏差。
en_tdlr: Under an additive period-cohort-tenure model of cell means, this paper characterizes which features of the panel conditioning path a staggered panel identifies—via the affine translate of the tenure projection of the cell design's kernel, containing affine and periodic directions exhausted under a connectivity condition—and shows how the unidentified component propagates bias into common panel estimators.
